name: sMother
source:
This is the story of an ordinary young man who, driven by an unusual fascination with his beautiful and dangerously seductive mother, accidentally discovers a dark secret hidden behind her perfect image.

A secret he decides to use in pursuit of something every son dreams about.

Making his mother happy.

The only question is whether he’ll be able to resist all the temptations that begin to unfold before him.

[From [url=https://subscribestar.adult/bottomless-pit]SubscribeStar[/url]]
translation:
这是一个普通年轻人的故事，他对美丽而危险的诱惑母亲有着不同寻常的迷恋，无意中发现了隐藏在她完美形象背后的黑暗秘密。

他决定利用这个秘密来追求每个儿子都梦想的事情。

让他妈妈开心。

唯一的问题是他是否能够抵制所有开始在他面前展开的诱惑。
